captures.description: THE EDITION'S NAME, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The term Pessoa Digital most commonly refers to digital academic and archival projects dedicated to the Portuguese poet Fernando Pessoa, or to municipal digital services in Brazil.' Section 1, the Digital Edition of Fernando Pessoa (pessoadigital.pt): 'A digital scholarly edition and research framework'; it 'connects with ... the Estranhar Pessoa project hosted by the Cologne Center for eHumanities (CCeH) and the National Library of Portugal collection'. Section 2, João Pessoa na Palma da Mão, the municipality's app of 'over 200 municipal services'. Cards: the CCeH's project page, the University of Rostock's page on the edition, three Instagram videos on the app.

atoms.evidence: A digital scholarly edition and research framework dedicated to the works and manuscripts of the renowned Portuguese writer Fernando Pessoa (1888–1935).
The digital edition is hosted by the DCH.
